title: Silence
description: Eugen Gomringer's Silencio, set again in Geist: fourteen copies of one word in a five by three grid, and the fifteenth slot left empty. Move anywhere on the page and the empty slot walks toward you one step at a time, each word sliding on a spring into the gap it leaves, so the poem's rhythm is never broken. Rest and the silence finds its way back to the centre. With sound on, a faint room tone falls to nothing wherever the gap is under you.
intent: From Gomringer's Silencio (1953/54), https://nickm.com/post/tag/concrete: the absence is the poem. Keep the grid exact and let the absence move, so the reader can carry the silence and watch it settle home.
